DE.source: Runtime-calibrated from the SOG SciPy differential-evolution profile

UPSO.source: SOG UPSO-labelled validation notebook and legacy unified-swarm controls

GIVP.source: Runtime-calibrated from the SOG GIVP Optuna configuration

notes: This profile is for a balanced-runtime comparison and must not be described as an exact historical SOG replay.
DE keeps the SOG SciPy strategy and recombination but reduces the population and iteration budget to shorten the runtime while preserving the historical search behavior.
GIVP increases the iteration and local-search workload so it stays in the same runtime band as the PSO/UPSO swarm runs.
This balanced profile is intended for dissertation-style runtime comparisons and not for exact historical replay.
Final comparisons use the paired reproducible seeds 44 through 48 for every algorithm.
